decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly negative today (NASDAQ -0.7%, S&P 500 -0.6%) with no clear risk-on catalyst. None of the screened candidates showed the full multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, RSI in bullish zone, price above SMA-20, and volume surge) needed for a high-conviction buy, so we held cash and existing positions unchanged rather than force a trade on a neutral day.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.7% and the S&P 500 down 0.6%, reflecting a mild risk-off tilt rather than any single dramatic catalyst. Trading was largely rotational, with fewer stocks showing the full combination of bullish signals (RSI momentum, MACD crossover, price above moving averages, and volume confirmation) that typically precedes strong rallies. Without confirmed institutional buying pressure across the screened list, the safer path was to preserve capital and open slots for a clearer setup.
market_education.summary_zh: 大盤今日普遍走弱,納斯達克指數下跌0.7%,標普500指數下跌0.6%,反映市場情緒偏向風險趨避,而非受單一重大事件驅動。今日交易呈現輪動格局,篩選名單中同時符合多項看漲訊號(RSI動能、MACD黃金交叉、股價站上均線及成交量放大)的股票不多。在缺乏明確的資金進場訊號下,選擇保留現金及空倉額度,等待更具說服力的進場時機較為穩健。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for several bullish signals to line up together — like a MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above key moving averages, and a volume surge — before committing capital, rather than acting on just one signal. On a quiet or mixed day like today, no candidate showed all of these together, so the disciplined move was to wait rather than chase a partial setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在投入資金前,等待多項看漲訊號同時出現——例如MACD黃金交叉、健康的RSI水平、股價站上重要均線,以及成交量放大——而不是僅憑單一訊號就進場。像今天這種市況平淡、訊號不一致的情況下,沒有任何候選股同時符合以上所有條件,因此耐心等待比追逐不完整的訊號更為紀律。
